description: We are building an AI-powered health monitoring system for astronauts on long-duration space missions. On missions to the Moon and Mars, communication delays mean the crew cannot rely on doctors on Earth in real time, so they need software that can detect and respond to health problems on its own.
summary:
ASTRA SENSE – ORBITAL GUARD is an offline-first astronaut health, crew readiness, and mission-continuity platform engineered for long-duration deep-space exploration where communication with Earth faces 14-to-24-minute delays or complete blackouts.

Developed with React 19, FastAPI, and an onboard persistent SQLite database in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode, the platform addresses deep-space isolation through 100% local autonomy. It integrates a 3-tier intelligence hierarchy: deterministic NASA-STD-3001 life-safety rules, unsupervised multi-variate anomaly detection (Scikit-Learn Isolation Forest) tracking neuro-fatigue and vital signs against personal baselines, sub-millisecond offline medical Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) retrieval, and auditable crew workload reassignments. When communications restore, a transactional outbox safely replicates mission data to a cloud database.

ORBITAL GUARD is critical because cloud-dependent health technologies fail during interplanetary blackouts. By providing zero-latency clinical decision support, preventing operational fatigue, and protecting vital medical supplies without relying on Earth, ORBITAL GUARD ensures that even when Earth goes silent, crew support and mission continuity continue uninterrupted.
details:
Project Details: ASTRA SENSE – ORBITAL GUARD

1. What does it do or how does it work?

ASTRA SENSE – ORBITAL GUARD is an autonomous, offline-first crew health, readiness, and mission-continuity platform engineered for deep-space exploration (such as Artemis Lunar Gateway and Mars transit missions).

The platform functions through a locally autonomous edge architecture:

Continuous Physiological Ingestion: Ingests high-frequency astronaut telemetry (heart rate, HRV, SpO2, core temperature, 3-axis IMU movement, and sleep debt). In our software prototype, an onboard multi-scenario telemetry engine simulates nominal and emergency flight modes (Normal, Neuro-Fatigue, Cabin Hypoxia, Cardiac Irregularity, and Custom).

3-Tier Intelligence Hierarchy:

Tier 1 (Deterministic Safety Rules): Executes instantaneous threshold checks (<1ms) based on NASA-STD-3001 spaceflight clinical guidelines (e.g., immediate 100% O2 mask alert if SpO2 drops below 90%).

Tier 2 (Explainable Anomaly Detection): Runs an onboard Scikit-Learn Isolation Forest model that compares multi-variate deviations against each astronaut’s historical baseline, outputting an anomaly score and ranking the top explainable contributing factors (e.g., HRV collapse + sleep debt accumulation).

Tier 3 (Clinical SOP Retrieval & Advisory): An onboard local knowledge base retrieves emergency Standard Operating Procedures (SOP-FATIGUE-01, SOP-HYPOXIA-02, SOP-ARRHYTHMIA-03) in 0.13 milliseconds with zero network calls. When communication with Earth is active, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash provides supplementary clinical dialogue.

Autonomous Crew Readiness & Workload Rebalancing: Evaluates crew readiness across 4 axes (Physical, Cognitive, Circadian, Cardiovascular). If an officer becomes impaired, the platform recommends a workload handover to a certified backup crew member and logs the transfer upon authorized human confirmation.

MedVault Pharmacy & Dual-Database Sync: Tracks critical medications and supplies with positive-stock boundary enforcement. Operations commit atomically to a local SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) database and queue into a Transactional Outbox, which asynchronously replicates to Supabase PostgreSQL whenever communication links with Earth reconnect.

2. What benefits does it have?

Zero Dependence on Earth Connectivity: Operates with 100% functionality during radio blackouts and communication delays, eliminating fatal waiting times during acute medical emergencies.

Prevents Alarm Fatigue through Personal Baselines: Rather than relying on blunt static thresholds, the multi-variate model evaluates individual microgravity physiological adaptation curves, drastically reducing false alarms.

Proactive Mission Continuity: Moves beyond passive health charting by actively rebalancing mission duties before human error threatens mission safety.

Resource Preservation: Prevents supply depletion through ACID-compliant inventory transactions and immutable audit logging.

Extreme Low Latency: Delivers sub-millisecond local queries and 0.13ms emergency medical guidance on standard spacecraft computing hardware.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

For Deep-Space Exploration: As humanity ventures to the Moon, Mars, and beyond, astronauts must become clinically self-reliant. ORBITAL GUARD decouples astronaut survival from ground control telemedicine, providing a vital safety net when Earth is out of reach.

For Terrestrial Extreme Environments: The underlying offline-first, edge-computing architecture directly translates to remote, disconnected environments on Earth—including Antarctic research stations, submarine crews, deep-sea oil platforms, remote mining sites, and tactical disaster triage zones where cloud access is unavailable.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

Programming Languages: Python 3.11, JavaScript (React / ES6+), SQL.

Frontend: React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Recharts.

Backend: FastAPI, Uvicorn (ASGI server), Pydantic v2, HTTPX.

Databases:

Local Operational Core: SQLite 3 in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode with persistent NVMe volume mounting (/data).

Cloud Archival Target: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) policies and RPC stored reconciliation procedures.

Machine Learning & Data Science: Scikit-Learn (Isolation Forest), NumPy, Pandas.

Cloud AI (Optional Supplementary Layer): Google Gemini 2.0 Flash API (via google-genai SDK).

DevOps, Containerization & CI/CD: Docker (multi-stage build: node:20-alpine builder + python:3.11-slim runtime), Railway Single-Service Container deployment, Git/GitHub.

Verification & Testing Suite: Pytest (44 automated unit/integration tests), custom End-to-End mission scenarios, failure simulation drills, secret scanners.

Hardware Concept & Prototyping Roadmap: ESP32 Wi-Fi/BLE microcontroller, MAX30102 pulse oximetry/heart-rate sensor, 3-axis accelerometer/IMU, OLED I2C display.

5. How is your project creative?

Ethical, Explainable AI Architecture: We rejected the temptation to blindly insert a black-box LLM into a life-critical system. Instead, our 3-tier hierarchy pairs rigid deterministic safety rules with an explainable Isolation Forest that transparently tells the crew why an anomaly was flagged.

Human-in-the-Loop Mission Rebalancing: Rather than merely triggering alerts, the system dynamically calculates crew coverage redundancy and formulates an actionable command handover that strictly requires authorized human confirmation.

Transactional Outbox for Interplanetary DSN Blackouts: We adapted enterprise distributed-systems patterns (the Transactional Outbox Pattern) to solve the aerospace challenge of Deep Space Network (DSN) dropouts, guaranteeing zero lost telemetry and automatic recovery upon reconnection.

6. What factors did your team consider?

Aerospace Communication Physics: The reality of 14-to-24-minute one-way radio latency and solar conjunction blackouts dictated our non-negotiable offline-first design.

Microgravity Spaceflight Physiology: We grounded our simulation models and clinical SOPs in NASA-STD-3001 and research from NASA’s Human Research Program (HRP)—incorporating cephalad fluid shifts, microgravity space anemia, circadian phase disruption, and Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) cognitive latency drift.

Ethical Boundaries & Medical Reality: We maintain strict engineering ethics: all prototype telemetry is explicitly watermarked as SIMULATED DATA, and the software is clearly positioned as a clinical decision-support and mission-continuity tool, not an autonomous robotic physician.

System Durability & Memory Safety: SQLite WAL mode with single-replica locks ensures ACID transaction safety, zero database corruption across container restarts, and microsecond performance on resource-constrained flight hardware.
